entries.title: Psalms 143:1
segments: ¶<<A Psalm of David.>> Hear my prayer, O LORD, Give ear to my supplications! In Your faithfulness answer me, [And] in Your righteousness.

entries.title: Psalms 143:2
segments: Do not enter into judgment with Your servant, For in Your sight no one living is righteous.

entries.title: Psalms 143:3
segments: For the enemy has persecuted my soul; He has crushed my life to the ground; He has made me dwell in darkness, Like those who have long been dead.

entries.title: Psalms 143:4
segments: Therefore my spirit is overwhelmed within me; My heart within me is distressed.

entries.title: Psalms 143:5
segments: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all Your works; I muse on the work of Your hands.

entries.title: Psalms 143:6
segments: I spread out my hands to You; My soul [longs] for You like a thirsty land. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 143:7
segments: ¶Answer me speedily, O LORD; My spirit fails! Do not hide Your face from me, Lest I be like those who go down into the pit.

entries.title: Psalms 143:8
segments: Cause me to hear Your lovingkindness in the morning, For in You do I trust; Cause me to know the way in which I should walk, For I lift up my soul to You.

entries.title: Psalms 143:9
segments: Deliver me, O LORD, from my enemies; In You I take shelter.

entries.title: Psalms 143:10
segments: Teach me to do Your will, For You [are] my God; Your Spirit [is] good. Lead me in the land of uprightness.

entries.title: Psalms 143:11
segments: Revive me, O LORD, for Your name's sake! For Your righteousness' sake bring my soul out of trouble.

entries.title: Psalms 143:12
segments: In Your mercy cut off my enemies, And destroy all those who afflict my soul; For I [am] Your servant.
